description: Redesign all news pages with real images and Ink & Oxblood design utilities; add the three new homepage sections (Trending/Most-Read, Explore by Topic, Editor's Picks). This feature touches the homepage, the news listing page, category pages, and article detail page, bringing them all to the new design language with images everywhere.
steps: Homepage (app/page.tsx): Insert three new sections in a sensible editorial order: (A) 'Trending / Most-Read' numbered list just after the Markets section -- display 5 articles numbered 01-05 from the latest 12, with image thumbnails, ranked-number pill, title, author, date. Use hairline-b separator, section-header, eyebrow, rule-grid patterns. (B) 'Explore by Topic' section after Trending -- 4 category tiles (Crypto, Economy, Markets, Banking) each linking to /news/category/<slug>, using getCategoryTone() for coloring, each with a brief description pulled from sampleCategories. Use the existing LineIcon set for icons (add new icon names to LineIcon.tsx if needed, e.g. 'chart', 'bank', 'globe'). Grid layout, rule-grid if appropriate. (C) 'Editor's Picks' band after Explore by Topic -- a secondary set of 3 articles (offset from the already-shown ones) with image cards. Use the existing ArticleCard in a rule-grid. Insert these three sections BETWEEN the existing 'Latest News' grid section and the 'Trust Signals' section. Do NOT move or remove the CryptoTicker, Top Story, Markets, Latest News, Calculators, Banks, or Newsletter sections. Keep the existing news-before-calculators ordering.

Fetch more articles on the homepage: change getLatestArticles(8) to getLatestArticles(12) so there is enough data for the featured hero (1), sidebar (4), grid (3), trending list (5 can reuse from first 12), and editor's picks (3 different offset). Alternatively deduplicate by clever slicing. Ensure no section is starved of articles.

News listing (app/news/page.tsx): Redesign to use Ink & Oxblood utilities. Replace the old `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-12` with `container-page section-padding hairline-b`. Replace `rounded-full border` category pills with inline text-links or an eyebrow-styled tab bar. Add a lead featured story with a large image at top (first article from the list). Remaining articles in a dense rule-grid with images (reusing ArticleCard). Use `section-header`, `page-title`, `eyebrow`, `rule-grid` etc. Ensure dark mode works.

Category page (app/news/category/[category]/page.tsx): Same treatment as the news listing page. Replace the old pills + rounded-lg with Ink & Oxblood utilities. Add a lead featured article with image and rule-grid for the rest. Active category tab should be distinguished using oxblood accent or bold ink instead of a bg-zinc pill.

Article detail (app/news/[slug]/page.tsx): Major enrichment. (a) Add a hero image at top using next/image with article.imageUrl, meaningful alt text, sharp corners. (b) Replace the grey placeholder author avatar `div` with a real next/image avatar from article.author.imageUrl (rounded-full only for the avatar, per design rules), or fall back to the grey circle. (c) Add reading time in the meta line ('5 min read'). (d) Restyle header and body sections using container-page/container-prose section-padding. Replace rounded-lg border on author bio aside with panel or panel-muted. (e) Restyle Related Articles at bottom to use rule-grid layout with the image-enabled ArticleCard, proper section-header + section-title. (f) Ensure breadcrumb, category badge, body text and everything works in dark mode.
Verify all pages work: homepage new sections render, news listing has lead+grid with images, category pages show correctly, article detail shows hero+avatar+readingTime+related.
acceptance_criteria: Homepage shows three new sections (Trending numbered list, Explore by Topic tiles, Editor's Picks cards) in correct order between Latest News and Trust Signals, fully styled with Ink & Oxblood utilities.
News listing (/news) has a lead featured story with large image and a dense rule-grid with image-enabled ArticleCards, using container-page/section-padding layout.
Category page (/news/category/crypto etc.) matches news listing style with active-tab distinction, lead story, and rule-grid.
Article detail shows hero image, author avatar (rounded-full), reading time, restyled prose and author bio, and Related Articles in a rule-grid.
Dark mode works on all modified pages. No emoji, no rounded-lg, no shadows, no hover lift.
`npm run lint` reports no warnings or errors and `npm run build` exits 0.
verification: Source nvm then run `npm run lint` — expect no errors.
Inspect the build route table to confirm all pages compile (/, /news, /news/[slug], /news/category/[category], etc.).
findings:
Homepage (app/page.tsx): bumped getLatestArticles(8)->getLatestArticles(12); featured=[0], sidebar=[1..5), grid=[5..8), trending=[0..5), editorsPicks=[8..11) so no section is starved. Inserted THREE sections between Latest News and Trust Signals in order: (A) 'Most Read' ordered list, 5 items numbered 01-05 (padStart) with oxblood serif rank, sm-only 112px next/image thumb, category eyebrow, title-link, author+date; uses divide-y hairline + rule-cell-hover. (B) 'Explore by Topic' rule-grid (lg:grid-cols-4) of 4 tiles crypto/economy/markets/banking, each linking /news/category/<slug>, pulling description from sampleCategories, tone from getCategoryTone(), LineIcon per topic. Added two glyphs to LineIcon.tsx (LineIconName union + PATHS): 'globe' (economy) and 'bank' (banking); crypto=coins, markets=bars reuse existing. (C) 'Editor's Picks' rule-grid of 3 ArticleCards offset from grid. Did NOT touch CryptoTicker/Top Story/Markets/Latest News/Calculators/Banks/Newsletter or their order. Added formatDate helper + Image/sampleCategories/getCategoryTone imports.
News listing (app/news/page.tsx): replaced 'mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-12' with hairline-b + container-page section-padding; replaced rounded-full pill tabs with eyebrow text-links ('All' active in oxblood, categories link to /news/category/<slug>); added lead featured story (2-col, large priority next/image, CategoryBadge, title-link, excerpt, author/date/reading time) and rendered rest in rule-grid of ArticleCards; empty state uses panel-muted.
Category page (app/news/category/[category]/page.tsx): same treatment; active tab distinguished with oxblood eyebrow (aria-current='page') instead of bg-zinc pill; breadcrumb restyled; lead story + rule-grid; panel-muted empty state.
Article detail (app/news/[slug]/page.tsx): added next/image hero (article.imageUrl, alt=title, sharp corners, priority) as <figure>; replaced grey placeholder avatar divs with real next/image rounded-full avatars from article.author.imageUrl (32px meta, 48px bio) with grey-circle fallback; added 'N min read' with tabular-nums to meta line; wrapped in container-page section-padding + container-prose; author bio aside now panel-muted (was rounded-lg); Related Articles now section-header + rule-grid. Dark mode preserved throughout.
Verification: `npm run lint` = 'No ESLint warnings or errors'; `npm run build` exit 0, all routes compiled (/ , /news, /news/[slug], /news/category/[category]); next-sitemap postbuild ran, public/sitemap.xml unchanged (not article-enumerated). Node requires sourcing nvm before npm. Did NOT create About page or edit config/site.ts / Footer.tsx (FEAT-003 scope). Did NOT push or open a PR.

Post-review polish (2026-08-31 review, 5 non-blocking items, all addressed): (1) Homepage editorsPicks slice(8,11)->slice(8,12) so all 12 fetched articles render; bumped Editor's Picks grid to lg:grid-cols-4 to keep 4 picks balanced. (2) data/sample-news.ts readingTime no longer uniform 5 — assigned varied 3-7 min values keyed per slug and kept identical between each card entry (sampleArticles) and its full-article entry (sampleFullArticles): bitcoin=6, fed=5, sp500=4, jpmorgan=5, ethereum=7, housing=4, tesla=3, fdic=5, solana=4, jobs=3, goldman-gold=4, bofa=3. (3) app/news/[slug]/page.tsx meta line: moved the '·' separator inside the article.author && guard so a missing author no longer renders an orphaned leading dot. (4) app/news/page.tsx active 'All' tab changed from non-focusable <span aria-current='page'> to focusable self-linking <Link href='/news' aria-current='page'>, matching the category page pattern for uniform keyboard/screen-reader behavior. (5) app/news/[slug]/page.tsx author avatars (32px meta + 48px bio) alt changed from {article.author.name} to alt='' so decorative avatars are skipped by screen readers (name is already visible text). Re-verified: `npm run lint` = no warnings/errors; `npm run build` exit 0. No design-language or dark-mode regressions; rounded-full still avatars-only.
